claims.text: Mondrian Hong Kong is in the Tsim Sha Tsui district, with quick access to key attractions and landmarks.

findings.quote: Situated in the vibrant Tsim Sha Tsui district with quick access to key attractions and landmarks

claims.text: Mondrian Hong Kong is the first Mondrian hotel in Greater China.

findings.quote: Mondrian Hong Kong marks the launch of the first Mondrian hotel in Greater China.
Mondrian Hong Kong is the brand’s first outpost in Greater China

claims.text: The hotel occupies a tall, slender tower with triangular windows that previously housed the Panorama Hotel.

findings.quote: inside a tall and skinny tower with triangular windows that previously housed the long-running Panorama Hotel

claims.text: The rooms reimagine heritage design motifs through a contemporary lens, against the backdrop of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline.

findings.quote: reimagining heritage design motifs through a contemporary lens, against the stunning backdrop of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline

claims.text: Rooms connect to the city's spirit through nuanced designs, local art and Victoria Harbour views.

findings.quote: connect to the city’s spirit through nuanced designs, local art, and stunning Victoria Harbour views

claims.text: Rooms feature washi-paper lamps, custom graphic rugs and bold hits of crimson and mustard.

findings.quote: bold hits of crimson and mustard, custom graphic rugs, washi-paper lamps

claims.text: The Harbour Suite has a lounge area, a connecting bedroom and two washrooms, one with a bathtub.

findings.quote: The suite features a stylish lounge area for relaxation and entertaining, a connecting bedroom, and two washrooms—one with a relaxing bathtub.

claims.text: The Cornershop art space is open to the public daily, free of charge, with no reservation required.

findings.quote: The Cornershop is open to the public daily, free of charge, and reservations are not required.

claims.text: The hotel regularly hosts cultural programmes, live music, DJ nights, brand collaborations and art-led experiences throughout the year.

findings.quote: Mondrian Hong Kong regularly hosts cultural programmes, live music performances, DJ nights, brand collaborations and art-led experiences throughout the year.

claims.text: Kowloon Park is a five-minute walk from the hotel.

findings.quote: Kowloon Park is just a five-minute walk from the hotel.

claims.text: Carna by Dario Cecchini is a contemporary Italian steak restaurant led by butcher Dario Cecchini, focused on premium cuts and nose-to-tail dining.

findings.quote: Carna by Dario Cecchini is our contemporary Italian steak restaurant led by legendary butcher Dario Cecchini, celebrating premium cuts and sustainable nose-to-tail dining.

claims.text: Avoca, on the 38th floor, serves creative cocktails and all-day dining.

findings.quote: Guests can also head to Avoca on the 38th floor for creative cocktails and all-day dining

claims.text: The open-air Roofgarden offers views of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline, a spot for sunrise, sunset or the city lights after dark.

findings.quote: Mondrian Hong Kong’s Roofgarden is an open-air social space designed for guests to unwind above the city.
Offering sweeping views of Victoria Harbour and the iconic Hong Kong skyline, it is an ideal spot to take in sunrise, sunset or the city’s glittering lights after dark.

claims.text: The Cornershop, a street-level space opposite the hotel, is dedicated to artistic pop-up experiences.

findings.quote: The Cornershop is a dynamic, street-level space opposite Mondrian Hong Kong that celebrates the possibilities of artistic pop-up experiences.

claims.text: The lobby has a two-story-high mosaic of underwater dancers and an orbital chandelier.

findings.quote: a glassy lobby opens with a two-story-high mosaic of underwater dancers, while an orbital chandelier casts ribbons of light across the room

claims.text: The Harbour Suite offers 180-degree views of the harbour or the Hong Kong cityscape through oversized windows.

findings.quote: Take in the breathtaking 180° views of the harbor or the vibrant Hong Kong cityscape through the oversized windows.

claims.text: Amsterdam-based designer Karin Krautgartner and her studio byKK transformed the interiors with bold, saturated hues.

findings.quote: Amsterdam-based designer Karin Krautgartner and her studio, byKK, completely transformed the previously run-of-the-mill decor with unapologetically bold and saturated hues
